title: One tree: every Inbox card now lives in the sessions store

owner_note.text: All 690 card folders (and their 24 index pages) moved from ai/2026/… into ai/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/cards/; ai/2026/ no longer exists. I kept each card's address the same (/framework/ai/2026/10/13/<card>/ still opens it in the Inbox), instead of giving cards new addresses inside the sessions store, so no old link or record breaks. Undo, one run at a time: node Server/TaskMove.mjs --undo --ledger card-moves. Servex and the dev server need one restart to run the new code; until then a brand-new card may land in the old place, and the same sweep moves it.
